map_info.description: Roll the known sphere into ten real pins along a long banked lane. The impulse initiates motion; contact distributes it. Compare a free and a braced launcher receiving equal opposite impulses. Keep the target bay as a separate question about what is selected. Reconstruct the sphere impulse and observe the pin contacts; pins need not become ten separate tutorials.
